claims.declared: Build a lane-owned, fail-closed round-evidence auditor that mechanically derives six defect classes from a round's committed wave bytes, reproducing the six defects the round-22 non-author spot-check routed (refusal arithmetic, wave/round caps, Gate spot-check row, per-attempt stale-lane grading, registry seat identities, landed-change LOG binding). Before: 0 classes mechanically detectable (no such script exists at baseline). After: 6/6 classes detected on round-22 committed evidence with per-class evidence pointers.
claims.control: A skip-work control (script that prints six findings unconditionally, or reads its own expectation file) must fail: the clean fixture must yield 0 findings and every check's green mutant must clear it. Round-21 evidence is the second control (must not yield the round-22 classes at all).
claims.killRule: Any class whose red fixture does not trip it, or whose green fixture still trips it, is removed from the counted set; the target then misses and the round reports an honest stop on that class.
claims.failureCapable: node scripts/round-evidence-audit.mjs --selftest -> cases=12, passed=12, exit 0; one mutant per check in each direction (red trips, green clears).

claims.declared: Admit one staged shokuknow entry (corpus-expansion-1 merge/tabi: the CSRF defence-shape boundary, a named PROVINCE/corpus frontier item: 'CSRF-checked submits untested by rule') only after this lane re-opens every cited source itself, and append the two SOURCES rows it cites, re-pointed by document, with this round's access date and located quotes. Documented-upstream only: no measured credit. Before: 0 admitted entries cite a row first opened this round (S102 absent from corpus/knowledge). After: 1.
claims.control: A skip-work control that copies the staged file verbatim without re-opening the sources fails the Gate: the located-quote check for S102/S103 (every quoted span must be found in the fetched bytes) would have no quote to show; and a staging-only append leaves used-by dangling. Adopting the staged bytes as-is is refused by the scratch census gate.
claims.killRule: If any cited quote is absent from the re-fetched source, the row is refused (not adopted) and C2 reports 0 / honest stop. If the entry duplicates held ground, it is not admitted as coverage and C2 reports the miss.

revisions.to: c1 fires when ANY cited '<n> whole-payload refusals' figure (lesson or report) differs from the count of committed refusal receipts carrying the capacity marker. c2 fires on a wave spec above the policy band, a registry larger than its spec, a wave with a spec and no dispatch receipt, or a round total above --round-cap. c3 fires when the lesson's ## Gate section contains neither 'spot-check' nor 'owed to closure'. c4 fires when two or more attempt receipts are committed and the report's Stale-lane paragraph grades fewer than two attempts (attempt number plus disposition). c5 fires when a wave with spawned seats has registry members without agentId. c6 fires when a landed-changes row cites only commits that touch no LOG.md and does not say where the entry lands.
revisions.why: A closure re-deriving the count needs the rules in words; these are the same sentences the code implements and the same labels the receipt prints.
